purpose: Teach: ふざけ/こだわら/街角/傾ける/間に合っ/ちらっと/町中/見回し

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨夜のパーティー、皆でふざけて、楽しかった。
lines.en: Last night's party was really fun — we were all just messing around.
lines.style: Warm, open delivery. Bright energy but grounded, not performative. Natural smile in the voice. Pace relaxed, reminiscing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。細かいルール、こだわらなくていい場、最高。
lines.en: Yeah. A place where you don't have to worry about all the rules — that's the best.
lines.style: Soft agreement, genuinely sincere. Relaxed breath. Quiet contentment underneath. Lean into the warmth without overplaying it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 駅の街角で、偶然、友達に会えた。
lines.en: And then I ran into a friend by chance at the station.
lines.style: Gentle, almost surprised wonder. Softness in the middle — the small grace of it. A touch of wistfulness that something so small felt meaningful.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 頭、お辞儀の時、深く傾けるよう、心がけてる。
lines.en: I try to bow deeply out of respect when I meet someone.
lines.style: Thoughtful and steady. Not preachy — just speaking about something she cares about. Slight intentionality on 'deeply', like it matters. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 予約に、ぎりぎり間に合った、ホッ。
lines.en: I barely made it to my reservation on time — phew.
lines.style: Light relief with a wry undercurrent. Quick intake of breath before 'phew'. Self-aware humor about rushing. Slight laugh threaded through.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: カフェの窓から、ちらっと、お客さんの様子、見える。
lines.en: From the cafe window I can catch glimpses of customers passing by.
lines.style: Observant and gentle curiosity. Pace unhurried. The tone of someone noticing small things with quiet attention. Slight trailing-off as if watching.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 町中の道、馴染んできた。
lines.en: I've gotten to know the streets of the town center pretty well now.
lines.style: Warm recognition, understated. Soft contentment — a sense of belonging settling in. Natural, conversational pace. Grounded in the present.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店内、見回しながら、不審者、警戒している。
lines.en: I'm always watching the shop, keeping an eye out for anything unusual.
lines.style: Alert but matter-of-fact, not tense. Practical attention — this is just part of the job. Steady gaze in the voice. No drama, just responsibility.
